analysis_populations.name: Full Analysis Set
analysis_populations.definition: All randomized subjects who receive at least one dose and have baseline and at least one post-baseline assessment.
analysis_populations.denominator_rule: Number of subjects in the FAS

analysis_populations.name: Safety Analysis Set
analysis_populations.definition: All subjects who receive at least one dose.
analysis_populations.denominator_rule: Number of subjects in the SAF

endpoints.name: Change from baseline in symptom score at Week 12
endpoints.definition: Week 12 symptom score minus baseline symptom score

estimands.objective: Estimate the treatment effect of ABC-101 versus placebo at Week 12
estimands.variable: Change from baseline in symptom score at Week 12
